subject: S11 migration 0013 (down 0012) is ready; 0011/0012 are not on shared yet — when do they land?
body: S11 is close to integrating (generator golden green, db/unit/vitest green, WebKit smoke green). My migration is 0013 with down_revision '0012' (S10), which chains on 0011 (S09). shared's head is still 0010, so I cannot integrate without breaking the single head. Options: (a) I wait for 0011+0012 (seg09/seg10: ETA?); (b) lead decides S11 lands now as 0013 with down_revision pointing at the current head and whoever lands next re-points (I'd rather not create that churn). I'll keep working on screenshots/CI prep and default to (a) unless lead says otherwise.
